published_source: Figure 3, Panel B (coefficients shown graphically only; joint Wald test of pre-period coefficients p = .87 reported in text).
replication_status: failed (synthetic data by design; published coefficients only in figure)
notes: Equation 2 event study, outcome ln(1 + monthly grocery item count). Authors' code (Figure 3B): feols(lnquantity ~ i(time_to_treat, treated, ref = c(-1, Inf)) | user_id + month_num, cluster user_id) on regdata_6m = matched households, adopters restricted to relative months -6..6 (month 0 INCLUDED in the code although the text says month 0 is excluded), controls all 27 months; reference l = -1. PROTOCOL DEVIATION FROM THE AUTHORS' SAMPLE: post-discontinuation months and the gap months between last confirmed use and first confirmed non-use (treatment switched off; 704 + 859 adopter-months) are dropped; the authors keep them in Figure 3. Month 0 kept as in the code (rel = 0 is the first treated period). run_spec.R event mode averages rel 0..6 (post) and -6..-2 (pre). Matched sample = 2,602 adopters + 2,602 never-adopters (MatchIt 1:1 nearest-neighbour logit, no replacement, Jul-Dec 2022 covariates; match.csv re-created in the work dir because the package does not ship it). SYNTHETIC DATA: the Dataverse package (doi:10.7910/DVN/SVWBNT) ships only Data_clean_synth; spending profiles are reshuffled across households and rescaled, so by design no coefficient reproduces (README Section 4). Adoption timing, use duration, discontinuation and stated reason are preserved; income is not. Nov 2 audit: event_structure added (identical to the legacy coding for this spec).

event_structure.source: Rmd Figure 3 block (work copy prep2_fig3_fig4.R lines 17-22): feols(y ~ i(time_to_treat, treated, ref = c(-1, Inf)) | user_id + month_num, cluster user_id) on regdata_6m = adopters with time_to_treat in [-6,6] (window trimmed; month 0 kept in the code) plus all months of matched controls. One indicator per relative month -6..6 except -1. rel = t_idx - g_idx equals time_to_treat on every adopter row (consecutive month index; month_num skips 663, t_idx does not).
event_structure.verified: fixest with es_assign on the rebuilt regdata_6m (N 103074) reproduces the authors' code coefficients on the SYNTHETIC data (authors_fig3_synthetic.csv) to max abs diff 4.4e-16. The pipeline sample (f3_panel.rds, N 101511) drops the post-discontinuation and gap months that the authors keep (switch-off, Hull fn. 6). Same structure as the legacy coding (ref -1, window -6..6, no rows beyond), so estimates do not move. All numbers on this package are from SYNTHETIC data (excluded from the main analysis).
